body_zh: 周二清晨，城东仓库共接收货车14辆，卸下纸箱2360件。其中家电类占三成，日用品占四成，其余为食品。当天出库订单1875单，比前一天多出210单，夜班为此加班了40分钟。
body_en: Early on Tuesday morning, the warehouse in the east of the city received 14 trucks and unloaded 2360 cartons. Household appliances made up three tenths of them, daily necessities four tenths, and food the rest. Outbound orders that day totaled 1875, which was 210 more than the day before, and the night shift worked 40 minutes of overtime as a result.

body_zh: 快递分拣中心的一条传送线在8小时内处理包裹约4万件，平均每分钟83件。扫描失败的包裹有96件，全部转入人工复核。破损件登记了7件，均为外包装受压变形，内物完好，已重新封箱后发出。
body_en: One conveyor line at the parcel sorting center handled about 40000 parcels in 8 hours, an average of 83 per minute. Scanning failed on 96 parcels, and all of them were passed on for manual checking. Seven damaged items were logged, all with outer packaging crushed out of shape and contents intact, and they were resealed and sent out.

body_zh: 这座冷链仓库分为三个温区，入口处的缓冲间常年保持在10度左右。最里面的冷冻区地面铺着防滑钢板，墙边码放着深蓝色的塑料托盘。顶部的风机低声运转，库门内侧挂着一排厚重的棉帘，叉车进出时帘子会轻轻摆动。
body_en: This cold chain warehouse is divided into three temperature zones, and the buffer room at the entrance stays at about 10 degrees all year round. The floor of the innermost freezer zone is covered with nonslip steel plates, and dark blue plastic pallets are stacked along the walls. Fans near the ceiling run with a low hum, a row of heavy padded curtains hangs inside the door, and the curtains sway gently whenever a forklift passes through.

body_zh: 货运站的月台长约两百米，沿线排列着二十多个装卸口。每个装卸口上方都有一块编号牌，下方装着可升降的钢制过桥板。月台边缘贴着黄黑相间的警示条，地面上画着白色的停车线，几辆挂车正倒靠在月台旁等待装货。
body_en: The platform at the freight station is about two hundred meters long, with more than twenty loading bays along it. Above each bay hangs a number plate, and below it sits a steel dock plate that can be raised and lowered. The edge of the platform is lined with yellow and black warning strips, white parking lines are painted on the ground, and several trailers have backed up against the platform to wait for loading.

body_zh: 包裹进入分拣中心后，先在卸货口被逐件放上传送带。随后经过龙门扫描架，运单条码被自动读取。分拣机根据目的地把包裹推入不同的滑槽，滑槽末端的工人将包裹装进对应的笼车。笼车装满后被推到发货区，等待干线车辆运走。
body_en: After parcels enter the sorting center, they are first placed one by one onto a conveyor belt at the unloading bay. They then pass through a gantry scanner, where the waybill barcodes are read automatically. The sorting machine pushes each parcel into a chute according to its destination, and workers at the end of each chute load the parcels into the matching cage carts. Once full, the carts are pushed to the dispatch area to wait for the trunk line trucks.

body_zh: 一批出口货物在装柜前，先由仓管员核对箱数和唛头。接着叉车把托盘按重量从里向外排列，重货放在底层，轻货压在上面。装到柜门附近时，工人用木条和充气袋把空隙填实。最后关门打上铅封，铅封号被记录在装箱单上。
body_en: Before a batch of export goods is loaded into a container, the warehouse keeper first checks the carton count and the shipping marks. Next, forklifts arrange the pallets by weight from the back toward the door, with heavy goods on the bottom and light goods on top. Near the container doors, workers pack the gaps tight with wooden strips and air bags. Finally the doors are closed and sealed, and the seal number is recorded on the packing list.

body_zh: 上周四傍晚，一辆运送瓷砖的货车在进入物流园时被限高杆拦下。司机下车查看后发现车厢顶部的篷布支架超出了限高。园区值班员引导货车绕到北门，那里的通道没有限高。货物在当晚九点前卸完，没有造成任何损失。
body_en: On Thursday evening last week, a truck carrying ceramic tiles was stopped by a height barrier as it entered the logistics park. The driver got out to look and found that the tarpaulin frame on top of the cargo box was above the height limit. The duty officer of the park guided the truck around to the north gate, where the passage had no height limit. The goods were unloaded before nine that night, and nothing was lost.

body_zh: 一家仓库在月底盘点时发现，有两箱保温杯的实际数量比账面少了12个。仓管员调出入库当天的监控和签收单，发现供货方送来的箱子里本来就少装了一层。供货方核实情况后，三天内补发了缺少的杯子，账面与实物重新对上了。
body_en: During its month end stocktake, a warehouse found that two cartons of insulated cups held 12 fewer cups than the books showed. The warehouse keeper pulled up the camera footage and the signed delivery receipt from the day the goods arrived, and found that the cartons from the supplier had been one layer short from the start. After checking the matter, the supplier sent the missing cups within three days, and the books matched the stock again.

body_zh: 快递面单上的条码对应着一串唯一的运单号，包裹在每个环节被扫描时都会留下一条记录。这些记录按时间先后排列，就构成了包裹的物流轨迹。如果某个环节漏扫，轨迹上就会出现一段空白，但包裹通常仍在正常运输途中。
body_en: The barcode on a shipping label corresponds to a unique waybill number, and each time the parcel is scanned at a stage, a record is left behind. Arranged in order of time, these records make up the tracking history of the parcel. If a scan is missed at some stage, a gap appears in the history, but the parcel is usually still moving through transit as normal.

body_zh: 货车运输中常用的计费方式有按重量和按体积两种。轻泡货占用空间大而重量轻，通常按体积折算计费。重货体积小而分量足，则按实际重量计费。承运方一般比较两种算法的结果，取其中较高的一个作为运费依据。
body_en: Truck freight is commonly charged in two ways, by weight or by volume. Light, bulky goods take up a lot of space but weigh little, so they are usually charged by converted volume. Heavy goods are compact and dense, so they are charged by actual weight. Carriers generally compare the results of the two methods and take the higher one as the basis for the freight charge.

body_zh: 这家海边酒店共有客房126间，七月第二周的平均入住率达到百分之九十二。早餐厅每天接待约310人次，高峰出现在上午八点前后。这一周前台共办理延迟退房41次，加床18次，行李寄存超过200件。
body_en: This seaside hotel has 126 guest rooms, and its average occupancy in the second week of July reached 92 percent. The breakfast hall served about 310 guests a day, with the peak around eight in the morning. During that week the front desk handled 41 late checkouts and 18 extra beds, and more than 200 pieces of luggage were stored.

body_zh: 客房部当天安排了14名服务员，每人平均清扫房间15间。退房房间的清扫用时约35分钟一间，续住房间约20分钟。全天更换床单和被套共380套，补充洗漱用品近900件，查房时发现3间房的灯泡损坏，已报工程部更换。
body_en: The housekeeping department scheduled 14 room attendants that day, and each cleaned an average of 15 rooms. A checked out room took about 35 minutes to clean, and a stayover room about 20 minutes. Over the day 380 sets of sheets and duvet covers were changed and nearly 900 toiletry items were restocked, and room inspections found broken light bulbs in 3 rooms, which were reported to the engineering department to be changed.

body_zh: 酒店大堂挑高约十米，正中垂下一盏由数百片玻璃组成的吊灯。前台是一整块浅灰色石材，背后的墙面嵌着竹编装饰板。大堂一侧摆着几组低矮的布艺沙发，另一侧的落地窗外是一片种满芭蕉的庭院，午后阳光会斜照进来。
body_en: The hotel lobby rises about ten meters, and a chandelier made of several hundred pieces of glass hangs from its center. The front desk is a single slab of light gray stone, and the wall behind it is inset with woven bamboo panels. Several groups of low fabric sofas stand on one side of the lobby, while beyond the floor to ceiling windows on the other side lies a courtyard planted with banana trees, where the afternoon sun slants in.

body_zh: 这条三日游线路从古镇出发，沿着一条河谷向上游延伸。第一天住在河边的木结构客栈，第二天翻过一道海拔一千多米的山口，傍晚抵达一处茶园。最后一天经过两座石拱桥和一片油菜花田，下午回到出发的车站。
body_en: This three day route sets out from an old town and follows a river valley upstream. The first night is spent at a timber inn by the river, and on the second day the route crosses a mountain pass more than one thousand meters above sea level, reaching a tea garden by evening. The last day passes two stone arch bridges and a field of rapeseed flowers, arriving back at the starting station in the afternoon.

body_zh: 入住手续通常在几分钟内办完。接待员先查找预订记录并确认入住天数，随后收取押金，打印一张登记单交给客人签字。接着制作两张房卡，并告知早餐的时间和楼层。最后行李员推着行李车把箱子送进房间，拉开窗帘后离开。
body_en: Checking in usually takes only a few minutes. The receptionist first looks up the booking and confirms the length of stay, then takes a deposit and prints a registration slip for the guest to sign. Next two key cards are made, and the guest is told the time and floor of breakfast. Finally a bellhop wheels a luggage cart to carry the cases into the room, draws back the curtains, and leaves.

body_zh: 一间退房客房的整理从撤换布草开始。服务员先开窗通风，把用过的床单和毛巾装进布草袋。接着清洁卫生间，从台盆一直擦到淋浴间。铺床时先套好被芯再摆放枕头，床尾搭一条叠好的毯子。最后补齐茶包和饮用水，关灯后锁门。
body_en: Turning over a checked out guest room begins with changing the linen. The attendant first opens the window to air the room and puts the used sheets and towels into a linen bag. Next comes the bathroom, wiped down from the basin all the way to the shower. When the bed is made, the duvet insert goes into its cover first and the pillows are placed after, with a folded blanket laid across the foot of the bed. Finally the tea bags and drinking water are restocked, and the door is locked after the lights are turned off.

body_zh: 一个二十人的旅行团原计划傍晚入住山顶的酒店，因山路临时封闭检修，车辆在半山腰停了两个小时。酒店得知情况后，把晚餐时间推迟到九点，并安排热汤保温。旅行团抵达时已是八点半，房卡已按名单分装在信封里，整齐摆在前台。
body_en: A tour group of twenty people had planned to check in at a mountaintop hotel in the early evening, but the mountain road was closed for repairs at short notice, and the coach waited halfway up the slope for two hours. On learning of the delay, the hotel moved dinner back to nine and kept hot soup warm. The group arrived at half past eight, and the key cards had already been sorted into envelopes by name and laid out neatly at the front desk.

body_zh: 暴雨过后，一家临江酒店的地下停车场进了约二十厘米深的积水。工程部连夜启动三台抽水泵，到凌晨四点积水已基本排净。第二天上午，酒店逐一联系了负一层十几辆车的车主，并提供了免费洗车。
body_en: After a heavy rainstorm, water about twenty centimeters deep flowed into the underground car park of a riverside hotel. The engineering department ran three pumps through the night, and by four in the morning the water had mostly drained away. The next morning, the hotel contacted the owners of more than ten cars on the first basement level one by one and offered them a free car wash.

body_zh: 酒店客房的门通常向内开启，门后贴着一张疏散示意图。图上标出了房间所在的位置，以及最近的两条安全通道。客房走廊每隔一段距离装有应急照明灯，停电时会自动亮起，照明时间一般不少于半小时。
body_en: Hotel room doors usually open inward, and an evacuation map is posted on the back of the door. The map marks the location of the room, as well as the two nearest emergency exits. Emergency lights are installed at intervals along the corridors, switching on automatically during a power cut and generally staying lit for no less than half an hour.

body_zh: 多数酒店的退房时间定在中午十二点，入住时间则在下午两点以后。中间这两个小时，客房部用来清扫和检查房间。旅游旺季时客房周转紧张，提前到达的客人往往先把行李寄存在前台，等房间准备好后再领取房卡。
body_en: Most hotels set checkout time at twelve noon, while check in starts after two in the afternoon. In the two hours between, the housekeeping department cleans and inspects the rooms. In the peak travel season rooms turn over tightly, so guests who arrive early often leave their luggage at the front desk first and collect their key cards once the rooms are ready.

body_zh: 十月份这户三口之家共用电286度，比九月少了54度。减少的部分主要来自空调，冰箱和热水器的用量与上月基本持平。洗衣机这个月运行了22次，每次耗水约50升，烘干功能只用了3次。
body_en: In October this family of three used 286 kilowatt hours of electricity, 54 fewer than in September. Most of the drop came from the air conditioner, while the fridge and the water heater used about the same as the month before. The washing machine ran 22 times this month, using about 50 liters of water each time, and its drying function was used only 3 times.

body_zh: 周六的大扫除从上午九点持续到下午一点。一家人擦洗了六扇窗户和两面镜子，清理出三袋旧报纸和一箱不再穿的鞋。抽油烟机的滤网浸泡40分钟后才洗干净，冰箱里过期的调料扔掉了7瓶，最后地板拖了两遍，屋里显得亮堂了许多。
body_en: The Saturday cleaning lasted from nine in the morning until one in the afternoon. The family scrubbed six windows and two mirrors and cleared out three bags of old newspapers and a box of shoes no longer worn. The range hood filter soaked for 40 minutes before it came clean, 7 bottles of expired seasonings were thrown out of the fridge, and finally the floor was mopped twice, leaving the rooms much brighter.

body_zh: 这间朝南的客厅不到二十平方米，墙面刷成了米白色。靠窗放着一张浅木色的长桌，桌上有一盆绿萝和一个陶瓷笔筒。沙发对面的矮柜上摆着电视和几本相册，地上铺着一块灰蓝色的圆形地毯，墙角立着一盏铁艺落地灯。
body_en: This south facing living room is under twenty square meters, with walls painted off white. A long table in light wood stands by the window, holding a pot of golden pothos and a ceramic pen holder. On the low cabinet opposite the sofa sit a television and a few photo albums, a round gray blue rug covers the floor, and a wrought iron floor lamp stands in the corner.

body_zh: 阳台角落里的滚筒洗衣机机身是白色的，正面有一扇圆形的玻璃门。门的上方是一排旋钮和按键，可选十几种洗涤程序。左上角的抽屉分成两个小格，分别盛放洗衣液和柔顺剂。底部有四个可调高度的支脚，运行时几乎没有晃动。
body_en: The front loading washing machine in the corner of the balcony has a white body and a round glass door on the front. Above the door is a row of knobs and buttons offering more than ten wash programs. The drawer in the upper left corner is divided into two small compartments, holding detergent and fabric softener respectively. Four height adjustable feet sit under the base, and the machine barely shakes while running.

body_zh: 空调室内机的清洗通常由家电师傅上门完成。他先切断电源，掀开前面板，取出两片过滤网，用清水冲净后放在阴凉处晾干。接着用软毛刷轻扫散热片，再用湿布擦净出风口的叶片。滤网干透后被装回原位，通电试运行十分钟后收工。
body_en: Cleaning the indoor unit of an air conditioner is usually done by a technician on a home visit. He first cuts the power, lifts open the front panel, takes out the two filters, rinses them with clean water, and leaves them to dry in a shady spot. Next he brushes the cooling fins lightly with a soft brush, then wipes the vanes of the air outlet clean with a damp cloth. Once the filters are completely dry they go back in place, and the job ends after a ten minute trial run with the power on.

body_zh: 每到周日，这家人都会把衣柜整理一遍。衣物先被全部取出铺在床上，按厚薄分成三堆。不常穿的厚外套装进真空收纳袋，压扁后放到柜子顶层。当季的衬衫按颜色从浅到深挂好，袜子和围巾卷起来放进抽屉的格子里。
body_en: Every Sunday, this family tidies the wardrobe. All the clothes are first taken out and spread on the bed, then sorted into three piles by thickness. Heavy coats that are seldom worn go into vacuum storage bags, which are pressed flat and placed on the top shelf. Shirts for the current season are hung from light to dark, while socks and scarves are rolled up and tucked into the compartments of a drawer.

body_zh: 一户人家的冰箱半夜突然停止制冷，第二天早上冷冻室的冰块已开始融化。主人联系了售后，维修员当天下午上门检查，发现温控器老化失灵。更换零件花了二十分钟，冰箱重新运转后，冷冻室在三个小时内降回了零下十八度。
body_en: A household fridge suddenly stopped cooling in the middle of the night, and by the next morning the ice in the freezer had begun to melt. The owner contacted the after sales service, a repairman came that afternoon to inspect it, and he found that the thermostat had worn out and failed. Changing the part took twenty minutes, and once the fridge was running again, the freezer dropped back to minus eighteen degrees within three hours.

body_zh: 楼上一户的洗衣机排水管松脱，水顺着地板缝渗到了楼下的天花板。楼下住户发现吊顶上出现一块黄色水渍，上楼敲门说明了情况。楼上住户立刻关掉水阀，重新固定了排水管，一周后又找工人把楼下的天花板重新粉刷了一遍。
body_en: The drain hose of a washing machine in an upstairs flat came loose, and water seeped through gaps in the floor into the ceiling below. The downstairs residents noticed a yellow water stain on their ceiling and went upstairs to knock and explain. The upstairs residents shut off the water valve at once and refastened the drain hose, and a week later they hired a worker to repaint the ceiling downstairs.

body_zh: 冰箱冷藏室的温度通常设在4度左右，食物在这个温度下能保存得更久。冷藏室的上层温度略高，常用来放熟食和剩菜。下层温度最低，适合存放鲜肉和鱼。门边的格架每次开门都会受热，温度波动最大，一般放饮料和调味品。
body_en: The fresh food compartment of a fridge is usually set to about 4 degrees, a temperature at which food keeps longer. The upper shelves are slightly warmer and are often used for cooked food and leftovers. The lower shelves are the coldest and suit fresh meat and fish. The door racks take in warm air every time the door opens, so their temperature varies the most, and they usually hold drinks and condiments.

body_zh: 木地板的含水率会随空气湿度变化，所以铺设时板与墙之间通常留出约一厘米的伸缩缝。梅雨季节木板吸湿膨胀，这道缝隙可以容纳变形，避免地板拱起。到了干燥的冬季，木板收缩，板缝会略微变宽，这属于正常现象。
body_en: The moisture content of a wooden floor changes with the humidity of the air, so an expansion gap of about one centimeter is usually left between the boards and the wall during installation. In the rainy season the boards absorb moisture and swell, and the gap takes up the change in shape so that the floor does not buckle. In the dry winter the boards shrink and the joints between them widen slightly, which is normal.

body_zh: 这家小型服装厂本月接到三笔订单，合计衬衫1800件。裁剪车间共用去白色棉布约2600米，损耗率控制在百分之四以内。缝制组12名工人分两班作业，平均每人每天完成车缝25件，月底前已全部包装入箱。
body_en: This small garment factory received three orders this month, totaling 1800 shirts. The cutting room used about 2600 meters of white cotton cloth, keeping waste within four percent. The 12 workers of the sewing team worked in two shifts, each sewing an average of 25 shirts a day, and everything was packed into cartons before the end of the month.

body_zh: 一卷出厂的亚麻布宽145厘米，长60米，每平方米约重180克。检验员抽查了十处样点，其中两处有轻微色差，一处有细小的断纱。经向缩水率为百分之三，纬向为百分之二，整卷被评为一等品。
body_en: A roll of linen leaving the mill measured 145 centimeters wide and 60 meters long, weighing about 180 grams per square meter. An inspector checked ten sample spots, finding slight color differences at two and a small broken yarn at one. Shrinkage was three percent along the warp and two percent along the weft, and the whole roll was rated first grade.

body_zh: 衣架上挂着一件深灰色的羊毛大衣，长度过膝，领口是宽大的翻驳领。前襟钉着两排牛角扣，每排三颗，袖口内侧缝着一圈同色的罗纹。里衬是酒红色的斜纹绸，口袋边缘用细密的明线压了一道，摸上去厚实而柔软。
body_en: A dark gray wool coat hangs on the rack, reaching below the knee, with a wide notched lapel. Two rows of horn buttons are sewn on the front, three in each row, and a band of matching rib knit is stitched inside each cuff. The lining is burgundy twill silk, and the edges of the pockets are finished with a line of fine topstitching, so the coat feels thick and soft to the touch.

body_zh: 布料市场的二楼是一排排狭长的档口，每家门前都挂满了布样。靠楼梯的几家专卖棉麻，布卷竖着靠在墙边，像一片彩色的木桩。走廊尽头是卖蕾丝和刺绣花边的摊位，玻璃柜里的样品按宽窄分格陈列，柜台上放着一把长长的木尺。
body_en: The second floor of the fabric market is lined with rows of long, narrow stalls, each with fabric samples hanging all over its front. The few shops near the stairs sell only cotton and linen, with bolts of cloth standing upright against the walls like a cluster of colorful posts. At the end of the corridor are stalls selling lace and embroidered trim, where samples in glass cases are displayed in sections by width, and a long wooden ruler lies on the counter.

body_zh: 裁缝做一条半身裙，第一步是用划粉把纸样的轮廓描到布面上，再沿线剪出前后两片和一条腰头。接着锁边防止脱线，把两侧的侧缝车合。装好拉链后缝上腰头，最后卷边熨平，一条裙子就完成了。
body_en: When a tailor makes a skirt, the first step is to trace the outline of the paper pattern onto the fabric with tailor chalk, then cut along the lines to get the front and back pieces and a waistband. Next the edges are overlocked to stop fraying, and the two side seams are stitched together on the machine. After the zipper is fitted the waistband is sewn on, and finally the hem is rolled and pressed flat, and the skirt is done.

body_zh: 制作扎染布时，工匠先把白布按图案折叠，用棉线紧紧捆扎。随后把布浸入蓝色染液，反复提起又放下，颜色便一层层加深。染好的布在清水中漂洗多遍，拆开棉线后晾在竹竿上，被捆住的地方留下了白色的花纹。
body_en: To make tie dyed cloth, the craftsman first folds white fabric according to the pattern and binds it tightly with cotton thread. The cloth is then dipped into a blue dye bath, lifted out and lowered again and again, so the color deepens layer by layer. The dyed cloth is rinsed many times in clean water, the threads are untied, and the cloth is hung on bamboo poles to dry, with white patterns left where it had been bound.

body_zh: 城南一间裁缝铺接到一套婚纱的修改单，新娘试穿时发现腰部松了两厘米。老师傅拆开侧缝重新收省，又把裙摆上松动的珠片一颗颗钉牢。原定三天的工期，他用了两天半完成，取衣当天婚纱挂在店门口的衣架上，引来不少路人驻足。
body_en: A tailor shop in the south of the city received an alteration order for a wedding gown, as the bride had found at her fitting that the waist was two centimeters too loose. The old tailor opened the side seams and took in the darts, then sewed the loose sequins on the skirt back on firmly one by one. The job had been scheduled for three days, and he finished it in two and a half, and on the day of collection the gown hung on a rack at the shop door, drawing many passersby to stop and look.

body_zh: 上个月，一所中学订购的八百套校服在交付前被发现袖长普遍偏短。服装厂追查后确认，是裁床上的一叠布料在铺布时被拉得过紧，裁下的袖片回缩了约一厘米。厂里重新裁制了这批袖子，交货日期推迟了一周。
body_en: Last month, eight hundred sets of school uniforms ordered by a middle school were found before delivery to have sleeves that were short across the board. After tracing the cause, the garment factory confirmed that a stack of fabric on the cutting table had been stretched too tight during spreading, so the cut sleeve pieces shrank back by about one centimeter. The factory recut the sleeves for the batch, and delivery was pushed back by a week.

body_zh: 布料的经纱沿着布匹的长度方向排列，纬纱横向穿过经纱。沿经向裁剪的衣片不容易变形，因此裤腿和衬衫前片多按经向排料。斜向裁剪的布片弹性最好，常用来做滚边条和垂坠感强的裙子，但也最容易被拉长。
body_en: The warp yarns of a fabric run along the length of the bolt, and the weft yarns pass crosswise through them. Pieces cut along the warp hold their shape well, so pant legs and shirt fronts are mostly laid out along the warp. Pieces cut on the bias stretch the most and are often used for binding strips and skirts that drape heavily, but they are also the easiest to pull out of shape.

body_zh: 羊毛纤维表面覆盖着一层细小的鳞片，遇到热水和反复揉搓时会相互勾连。纤维越缠越紧，毛衣随之缩小变硬，这种现象叫作毡化。羊毛衣物的洗涤标签上大多标着冷水手洗或干洗，洗后通常平铺晾干，以免衣身被水的重量拉长。
body_en: The surface of a wool fiber is covered with tiny scales, which hook into one another under hot water and repeated rubbing. As the fibers tangle ever more tightly, a sweater shrinks and stiffens, a process called felting. The care labels of wool garments mostly call for cold hand washing or dry cleaning, and after washing the garments are usually laid flat to dry so that the weight of the water does not stretch them.

body_zh: 凌晨五点，这艘渔船结束了为期六天的作业返回渔港。船上共卸下冰鲜带鱼约3200公斤，鲳鱼约900公斤，另有梭子蟹十一筐。码头过磅用了将近两个小时，当天带鱼的收购价比上周每公斤高出两元。
body_en: At five in the morning, this fishing boat returned to port after six days at sea. It unloaded about 3200 kilograms of iced hairtail, about 900 kilograms of pomfret, and eleven baskets of swimming crabs. Weighing at the quay took nearly two hours, and the buying price of hairtail that day was two yuan per kilogram higher than the week before.

body_zh: 渔港管理站的统计表显示，本周进港渔船共计147艘次，比上周增加了23艘次。拖网船有91艘次，刺网船和运输船合计56艘次。周三因大风停航一天，周五的卸货量最大，达到约58吨。
body_en: The tally sheet of the port management station showed 147 fishing boat arrivals this week, 23 more than the week before. Trawlers accounted for 91 arrivals, and gillnetters and carrier vessels for the other 56. Sailings stopped for a day on Wednesday because of strong wind, and Friday saw the largest landings, at about 58 tonnes.

body_zh: 渔港坐落在一处半月形的海湾里，东侧的防波堤伸出海面约三百米。港池里停泊着上百艘刷着蓝漆的木壳渔船，桅杆上挂着褪色的彩旗。岸边一排低矮的冷库外墙结着盐霜，码头的石板缝里散落着鱼鳞，空气中带着淡淡的咸腥味。
body_en: The fishing port sits in a half moon bay, and the breakwater on its east side extends about three hundred meters into the sea. More than a hundred wooden fishing boats painted blue are moored in the harbor basin, with faded pennants hanging from their masts. Salt frost coats the outer walls of a row of low cold stores along the shore, fish scales lie scattered in the cracks between the flagstones of the quay, and the air carries a faint salty smell of fish.

body_zh: 停在三号泊位的那艘拖网渔船是钢质船体，全长38米左右，船身漆成深绿色。后甲板上装着两台绞车和一个巨大的门形吊架，渔网卷在滚筒上。甲板下方是鱼舱，四壁贴着保温板，可以装下二十多吨碎冰和渔获。
body_en: The trawler moored at berth three has a steel hull about 38 meters long, painted dark green. Two winches and a huge gantry frame stand on the rear deck, and the net is wound on a drum. Below deck lies the fish hold, its walls lined with insulation panels, able to take more than twenty tonnes of crushed ice and catch.

body_zh: 每天清晨，码头工人把刚卸下的渔获倒在长长的分拣台上。他们按品种和大小把鱼分进不同的塑料筐，挑出破损的个体。分好的鱼逐筐过磅登记，盖上一层碎冰，再由叉车运进冷库预冷。批发市场开门后，这些鱼被装上冷藏车分送出去。
body_en: Every morning at dawn, dock workers tip the freshly landed catch onto a long sorting table. They sort the fish by species and size into different plastic crates and pick out any damaged ones. The sorted fish are weighed and logged crate by crate, covered with a layer of crushed ice, and moved by forklift into a cold store to chill. After the wholesale market opens, the fish are loaded onto refrigerated trucks and sent out.

body_zh: 鳗鱼干的晒制大致分为三个阶段。渔家先把鳗鱼从背部剖开，去掉内脏和脊骨后用海水洗净。第二阶段是抹盐腌制半天，再用竹片撑开鱼身。最后挂到海边的木架上风吹日晒三到五天，鱼肉变得紧实透亮后便收起来捆扎成束。
body_en: Drying eels takes roughly three stages. Fishing families first split the eels open along the back, remove the innards and backbone, and wash them clean in seawater. The second stage is rubbing them with salt and curing them for half a day, then spreading each body open with bamboo strips. Finally they hang on wooden racks by the sea for three to five days of wind and sun, and once the flesh turns firm and translucent, they are taken down and tied into bundles.

body_zh: 一艘小型渔船在返航途中螺旋桨被废弃渔网缠住，船只失去动力漂在海上。船长通过无线电联系了附近作业的另一艘渔船。两个小时后，对方赶到并用缆绳把渔船拖回港口，潜水员随后清理了缠绕物，船上三名船员均安然无恙。
body_en: On its way back to port, a small fishing boat had its propeller fouled by an abandoned fishing net and lost power, drifting at sea. The skipper radioed another fishing boat working nearby. Two hours later the other boat arrived and towed the vessel back to port with a rope, a diver then cleared away the tangled net, and the three crew members on board were all unharmed.

body_zh: 今年开渔节后的第一个早晨，渔港码头比平时热闹许多。四十多艘渔船陆续靠岸，鱼贩们天不亮就守在泊位旁。一船刚卸下的梭子蟹在半小时内被抢购一空，收购商临时加开了两辆冷藏车，直到中午码头才渐渐安静下来。
body_en: On the first morning after the fishing festival this year, the quay of the fishing port was much busier than usual. More than forty boats came in one after another, and fish traders had been waiting by the berths since before dawn. A boatload of freshly unloaded swimming crabs sold out within half an hour, the buyers sent two extra refrigerated trucks at short notice, and the quay did not grow quiet until noon.

body_zh: 海鱼捕捞后体内的酶仍在活动，鱼肉在常温下几个小时就会变软。渔船上通常用碎冰把渔获层层覆盖，使鱼体温度保持在零度附近。冰与鱼的比例一般约为一比一，天气炎热或航程较长时，加冰的比例还会更高。
body_en: After sea fish are caught, the enzymes in their bodies stay active, and at room temperature the flesh softens within a few hours. Fishing boats usually cover the catch layer by layer with crushed ice, keeping the fish near zero degrees. The ratio of ice to fish is generally about one to one, and in hot weather or on longer voyages the share of ice is even higher.

body_zh: 渔港里的水深会随潮汐涨落而变化，一天之中通常有两次高潮和两次低潮。吃水较深的大渔船多在涨潮时进出港，这样不会在航道浅处搁浅。由于潮汐的时间每天推迟约五十分钟，渔船出海的钟点也随之后移，大约半个月循环一次。
body_en: The depth of water in a fishing port rises and falls with the tide, and there are usually two high tides and two low tides in a day. Large fishing boats with deep drafts mostly enter and leave the port on a rising tide, so they do not run aground in the shallow parts of the channel. Because the tides come about fifty minutes later each day, the departure times of the boats shift later too, in a cycle of roughly half a month.
